q-0336.answer:
Surah Yunus (10) — Jonas · 109 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• If you find that it is too much of an offense that I should live among you and preach to you the revelation of Allah and His signs and proofs, then I do not care what you think, and I will not stop inviting you.
• We should worship Allah alone without partners while having different laws.
• Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the wise Book
• Have the people been amazed that We revealed [revelation] to a man from among them, [saying], "Warn mankind and give good tidings to those who believe that they will have a [firm] precedence of honor with their Lord"? [But] the disbelievers say, "Indeed, this is an obvious magician."
• Indeed, your Lord is Allah, who created the heavens and the earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne, arranging the matter [of His creation]. There is no intercessor except after His permission. That is Allah, your Lord, so worship Him. Then will you not remember?

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Surah Al-Anbiyaa (21) — The Prophets · 112 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Your Lord, beside Whom there is no other god, is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and all that they contain; He is the One Who initiated their creation; He is the Creator of all things.
• I have already informed you that I have nothing to do with you and you have nothing to do with me.
• Speaking to your fathers whose actions you cite as evidence would be the same as speaking to you.
• I declare that I am in a state of war with you as you are in a state of war with me.
• I do not know, perhaps it is a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0534.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0541.answer:
Surah As-Saff (61) — The Ranks · 14 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• None is more unjust than he who lies about Allah and calls upon rivals and associates partners with Him, even while he is being invited to Tawhid and sincerely worshipping Him.
• We will support you with regards to the Message you have been sent with and will help you convey it.
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
• Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

q-0659.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

Transliteration: Yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish Shaitaan; wa many-yattabi' khutuwaatish Shaitaani fa innahoo yaamuru bilfahshaaa'i walmunkar; wa law laa fadlul laahi 'alaikum wa rahmatuhoo maa zakaa minkum min ahadin abadanw wa laakinnal laaha yuzakkee many-yashaaa'; wallaahu Samee'un 'Aleem

Translation: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. q-5014.answer:
Surah Al-Balad (90) — The City · 20 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Man is encompassed by Allah and His Bounties
• He was from the believers who worked righteous deeds, and advised each other to be patient with the harms of the people, and to be merciful with them.
• Then, along with these beautiful and pure characteristics, he was a believer in his heart, seeking the reward of that from Allah.
• It will be sealed over them and there will be no way for them to avoid it, nor will they have any way out.

Surah At-Taariq (86) — The Morning Star · 17 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• How Man is Created is a Proof of Allah's Ability to Return Him to Him
• Rather it is serious and true. Then Allah informs about the disbelievers saying that they reject Him and hinder others from His path.
• On the Day of Judgement the secrets will be tested.
• A little while. This means that you will see what befalls them of torment, punishment and destruction.
• From other than himself. This statement means that he will not be able to save himself from the torment of Allah, and nor will anyone else be able to save him.
